label: Client ID
name: Sales Invoice-custom_client_id
description: Van Sale idempotency key — matches Vansale Outbox.client_id

label: Return Reason
name: Sales Invoice-custom_return_reason
options:
Damaged
Expired
Wrong Item
Customer Refused
Short Delivery
Other
description: Why the goods came back. Structured so returns can be reported on by reason — the free-text detail goes in Remarks. Mandatory for app returns (enforced in vansale.api.sales_return.save) rather than via reqd, so desk users amending historical credit notes are not blocked.
